title: NCAA: Lyceum overcomes Arellano for strong end to crossover phase
summary: Lyceum concluded the crossover phase of the NCAA Season 102 men's basketball tournament on a strong note, taking down Arellano 62-57 on Thursday at the FilOil EcoOil Centre in San Juan.
